top_violation_types.title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §744.2659)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation had two expired medications at the operation for children that the medication was prescribed for.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §744.605(16))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 7 children with diagnosed food allergies did not have signed food allergy emergency plans or medication present for their allergies.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children (26 TAC §744.1203(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was found children were leaving the classroom to use the restroom and use the water foutain unsupervised.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know how many children responsible for (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not know the number of children they were caring for during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §744.1203(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: When switching groups a caregiver did not inform the other caregiver how many children were in the group

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §744.2655(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children's medication did not have the date that the medication was left at the operation.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.
